# Calon AI

> Calon AI (CALON AI SOLUTIONS LIMITED, Companies House 15984397) is a Welsh operational AI and automation consultancy for founder-led service businesses across the UK. We connect the tools a business already uses (CRM, Xero, job management, inboxes, spreadsheets), automate the admin around them and build AI agents and dashboards so founders can see margin, jobs and follow-ups in one place. Based in Caerphilly and Treforest (University of South Wales), Wales. Founder-led: clients work directly with the people who build the systems.

Contact: contact@calonaisolutions.com · 03301 332 508 · https://calonaisolutions.com/contact

## Case studies
- [Volt Secure: Operational Platform & CRM Replacement](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/volt-secure-operational-platform): A Welsh fire and security installer was running quotes, jobs and customers across five disconnected tools. We replaced the lot with one purpose-built operational platform.
- [Volt Secure: Timesheet Verification & Payroll Workflow](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/volt-secure-timesheet-payroll): Engineer timesheets were costing a full Monday morning every week and triggering payroll disputes. We built a verification workflow that finalises the week automatically.
- [HeatGlow: AI Lead Vetting & Qualification Flow](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/heatglow-lead-vetting): A Cardiff heating installer was treating every website enquiry the same way. Serious customers were waiting 48 hours while the team chased time-wasters. We built the AI filter that changed that.
- [HeatGlow: AI Customer Reactivation Campaign Manager](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/heatglow-reactivation-campaign): Years of dormant customer data was sitting in the CRM untouched. We built the AI campaign manager that turned it into £18k of recovered revenue in 90 days.
- [Construction Skills Wales: Fully Automated Learner Onboarding](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/construction-skills-wales-onboarding): Learner onboarding was a three-day manual process and one in four learners started with incomplete files. We automated the entire intake.
- [Construction Skills Wales: AI Document Chasing & Compliance](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/construction-skills-wales-documents): The team was spending more time chasing paperwork than processing it. We built an automated chase workflow that protects the audit position and frees up the admin team.
- [UK Fire & Security Installer: Engineer Job Management & Evidence Capture App](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/fire-security-engineer-app): Field engineers were finishing jobs without consistent evidence capture. Photos were on phones, signatures on paper, and the post-job admin was a guessing game. We built the mobile app that fixed it.
- [UK Heating Business: Pipeline & Commercial Reporting Dashboard](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/heating-pipeline-dashboard): The director was running commercial decisions off a weekly spreadsheet and instinct. We built the live dashboard that put margin and pipeline in front of him every morning.
- [UK Construction Training Provider: Centralised Admin & Operations Dashboard](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/training-provider-ops-dashboard): Cohort tracking and funding claims were spread across seven spreadsheets owned by different team members. We unified everything into a single MD-level view.
- [UK Renewables Installer: Partner Network Platform](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/renewables-partner-platform): Leads were being distributed to regional partners by WhatsApp and forgotten about. We built the partner platform that put SLAs, visibility and revenue share on a single rail.
- [UK Solar Installer: AI Quote & Sales Pipeline Workflow](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/renewables-quote-pipeline): A single estimator was bottlenecking the entire business. Quotes took five to seven days while competitors quoted same-day. We rebuilt the workflow around a configurable pricing engine.
- [UK Renewables Sector: White-Label Platform Productisation](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/renewables-white-label-platform): An internal operational platform had crossed the threshold from "tool" to "potential product". We built the architecture that turned it into recurring revenue.
- [UK Fire & Security Business: AI Enquiry Handling & Response Workflow](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/fire-security-enquiry-ai): One in five enquiries was getting no response within 48 hours. Competitors were responding within the hour. We built the AI workflow that closed the gap.
- [UK Smart Security Firm: Enquiry-to-Job Workflow MVP](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/smart-security-mvp): The founders had a clear vision but no working system to back it. We built a 7-screen MVP in three weeks that unlocked their investor and franchisee conversations.
- [UK Health & Safety Training Provider: Sales & Onboarding Automation](https://calonaisolutions.com/work/health-safety-training-automation): The whole business was capped by the owner’s calendar. We built the sales and onboarding automation that let the business run even when he was teaching.

## Resources (guides, fixes, comparisons and AI news)
- [Calon AI Resources hub](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources): practical AI guides for business owners and teams
- [ChatGPT Not Working? How to Fix the Most Common Errors](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/chatgpt-not-working): Fix "Something went wrong", network errors, login loops and slow or missing replies in ChatGPT. Step-by-step checks in the order most likely to work.
- [Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: What Anthropic Announced and What It Means](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/claude-fable-5-2-mythos-5-2): Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on 9 November 2026. What changed, who can use each model, API pricing and what it means for businesses.
- [Claude Not Working? Every Claude Error Message Explained and Fixed](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/claude-errors-fixes): What Claude's usage limit, length limit, capacity and login errors mean, and exactly how to fix each one. Based on Anthropic's official troubleshooting guidance.
- [Claude vs ChatGPT for Business: Which Should Your Team Use?](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/claude-vs-chatgpt): An honest comparison of Claude and ChatGPT for business use: strengths, plans, data controls and integrations, plus a simple way to decide for your own team.
- [Getting Started with Claude Code: Install, First Task and Best Practices](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/claude-code-getting-started): Install Claude Code on Mac, Windows or Linux, run your first task, set up CLAUDE.md and work safely with an AI coding agent. Commands from the official docs.
- [How to Automate Customer Support with AI (Without Annoying Your Customers)](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/ai-customer-support-small-business): A practical guide to AI customer support for small businesses: instant replies, triage, draft responses and chatbots, with what to automate and what to keep human.
- [How to Automate Repetitive Business Tasks with AI: A Practical Framework](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/automate-repetitive-business-tasks): Find the tasks worth automating, choose between simple automation and AI, and build your first workflow. A practical framework with real examples from UK businesses.
- [How to Connect Two Business Apps: Native Integrations, No-Code Tools and APIs](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/connect-business-apps): Four ways to make your business apps talk to each other: native integrations, Zapier or Make, webhooks and APIs. How to pick the right one, step by step.
- [How to Use ChatGPT: A Practical Beginner's Guide for Work](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/how-to-use-chatgpt): Learn how to use ChatGPT step by step: signing up, writing good requests, uploading files, Projects, memory and custom instructions, with real work examples.
- [How to Use Claude AI: Projects, Artifacts and Everyday Workflows](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/how-to-use-claude): A step-by-step guide to Claude by Anthropic. Sign up, write good requests, use Projects for ongoing work, create Artifacts and pick the right plan for you.
- [How to Write Better AI Prompts: A Practical Guide with Templates](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/prompt-engineering-guide): A practical prompt guide for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini: a simple five-part structure, before-and-after examples and copy-ready business templates.
- [Is It Safe to Use ChatGPT and Claude with Company Data? A UK Business Guide](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/ai-data-privacy-uk-business): What UK businesses need to know before staff use AI tools with customer or company data: UK GDPR basics, business vs personal accounts and a simple AI policy.
- [Zapier vs Make vs n8n: Which Automation Tool Should You Choose?](https://calonaisolutions.com/resources/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n): Zapier, Make and n8n compared for small businesses: how each bills, ease of use, AI features, hosting and data control, with clear advice on which to pick.
